runs.t: “You should have come sooner,” said Emma. “Say nothing more,” Jack replied. “That will not be enough,” said Alice, and looked at Robert. The next day Jack set off with the sack of salt under one arm, without saying goodbye.
The lamplight trembled as someone opened the door. “I do not know,” said Mary. “It was never my decision,” Tom replied. Outside the rain fell against the shutters, steady and unhurried.

It was a grey noon, and in the yard nothing stirred. Alice searched for the sack of salt for a long time under the bridge, without success. Alice arrived behind the wall when Mary had already left. The lamplight trembled as someone opened the door. “Say nothing more,” said Alice, and looked at Emma. It was late afternoon, and in the yard nothing stirred.
